Coram: Honble Mr. Justice Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi

For the Petitioner :-Mr. S.K. Deo, Advocate For the State : Mr. Deepankar Roy, Advocate
----
05/17.10.2023

This petition has been filed for direction upon the respondents to punish respondent
no.8-Investigating Officer of Rikhiya P.S. Case No. 85 of 2022 for the offence under sections 323,
498A, 506 of the I.P.C. and further prayer has been made for compensation to the tune of Rs. 5
lakhs.
2.  Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that on 30.03.2022 complaint case was field and on 28.04.2022 pursuant to direction of the learned Court F.I.R. was lodged.
He submits that the petitioner has not received any notice under section 41-A of Cr.P.C.
He submits that the petitioner was arrested on 20.01.2023.
He submits that in violation of guidelines made in the case of "Arnesh Kumar Vs. State of Bihar and Another (2014) 8 SCC 273, arrest has been made.

entities.text: Arnesh Kumar Vs. State of Bihar and Another (2014) 8 SCC 273
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. Mr. Deepankar Roy, learned counsel or the respondent- State submits that 41-A of Cr.P.c. notice was issued to the petitioner on 22.11.2022, 29.12.2022 and 10.01.2023 but the petitioner has not appeared.

He submits that the petitioner was arrested as he was not cooperating in the investigation and thereafter he was produced before the learned Magistrate within time and he was remanded in judicial custody by order dated 20.01.2023.
4.
In the counter-affidavit issuance of notice under section 41-A Cr.P.C has been disclosed in case diary.
There is disputed question of facts.
How the guidelines issued in the case of "Arnesh Kumar"(supra) case is not followed in the case in hand not demonstrated by the petitioner.
No relief can be extended to the petitioner.
